license_required.quote: A person may not practice podiatry unless licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: The division shall issue to persons qualified under this chapter a license in the classification of podiatric physician.

degree_required.quote: having received an earned degree of doctor of podiatric medicine from a podiatry school or college accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

available.quote: a person residing in another state and licensed to practice podiatry there, who is called in for a consultation by a person licensed in this state

requirements.value: A person residing in another state and licensed to practice podiatry there may be called in for consultation or invited to conduct a lecture, clinic, or demonstration, so long as they do not establish a place of business or regularly engage in the practice of podiatry in the state.
requirements.quote: a person residing in another state and licensed to practice podiatry there, who is called in for a consultation by a person licensed in this state and services provided are limited to that consultation or who is invited by a recognized school, association, society, or other body approved by the division to conduct a lecture, clinic, or demonstration of the practice of podiatry so long as that individual does not establish a place of business or regularly engage in the practice of podiatry in the state

drug_authority.value: Podiatric physicians may prescribe drugs; unlawful prescribing is unprofessional conduct
drug_authority.quote: unlawfully prescribing, selling, or giving away any prescription drug, including controlled substances, as defined in Section 58-37-2

amputation_authorized.quote: An individual licensed as a podiatric physician under this chapter may not perform an amputation proximal to Chopart's joint.

anesthesia_authority.quote: does not administer anesthesia, except for a local anesthetic

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: an individual licensed as a podiatric physician under this chapter may perform a surgical procedure on a bone of the foot or ankle

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: graduated on or after June 1, 2006, from a three-year residency program in podiatric medicine and surgery

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: in an ambulatory surgical facility, a general acute hospital, or a specialty hospital, as defined in Section 26B-2-201
